# SpyReels

> SpyReels is an AI-powered Instagram Reels intelligence and script generation platform built for nano and micro creators under 50K followers.

## What SpyReels Does
- Analyzes any public Instagram account and surfaces all Reels with view counts, likes, and comments
- Transcribes Reels audio into full text using proprietary AI
- Breaks down the viral hook and content structure of any Reel
- Generates new Reels scripts based on proven viral structures using advanced AI
- Built-in script editor with 8 AI tools: grammar check, tone adjustment, simplify, shorten, rewrite, phrase swap, and more
- Generates SEO-optimized Instagram captions and hashtags
- Full-screen teleprompter for confident filming
- Chrome extension for collecting Reels while browsing Instagram
- Telegram bot for saving Reels directly from your phone

## Who It Is For
Instagram creators with under 50,000 followers who want to grow faster by studying what works in their niche and creating better content with AI assistance.

## Pricing
Free plan available. Paid plans start at $19/month across five tiers: Free, Starter, Pro, Business, and Agency.
